description: This file defines a Go package 'labels' that provides interfaces, types, and functions for managing and manipulating label sets, including conversion, validation, merging, and conflict detection.

classes.name: Labels
classes.description: Interface for label collections, providing methods to check existence and retrieve values.

classes.name: Set
classes.description: Type alias for a map of string to string, representing a set of labels with methods for string representation, conversion, validation, and manipulation.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns all labels as a human-readable string in key=value format, sorted for determinism.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if a label exists in the set.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given label key.

methods.name: AsSelector
methods.description: Converts labels to a Selector object without validation.

methods.name: AsValidatedSelector
methods.description: Converts labels to a Selector object with client-side validation.

methods.name: AsSelectorPreValidated
methods.description: Converts labels to a Selector assuming labels are already validated.

methods.name: FormatLabels
methods.description: Converts a label map to a string, returning '<none>' if empty.

methods.name: Conflicts
methods.description: Checks if two label sets have conflicting key-value pairs.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges two label sets, with the second set overwriting conflicts.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if two label sets are equal.

methods.name: AreLabelsInWhiteList
methods.description: Verifies if labels are within a specified whitelist.

methods.name: ConvertSelectorToLabelsMap
methods.description: Parses a selector string into a label set with validation.
